tools.name: wakatime_get_user
tools.description: The WakaTime user this key belongs to: id, username, display name, email, timezone, plan, last plugin/project/branch and last heartbeat time. GET /users/current.

tools.name: wakatime_get_summaries
tools.description: Coding activity as one summary per day for a date range: grand total plus breakdowns by project, language, editor, operating system, category, dependencies and machine, with cumulative total and daily average. Give start and end, or one named range. Use project (and branches) to also get per-branch

tools.name: wakatime_get_stats
tools.description: Aggregated coding stats for a range: total time, daily average, best day, AI vs human line changes, and the full breakdown by language, project, editor, operating system, category, dependencies and machine. If the reply says it is still calculating, call again shortly. GET /users/current/stats/{rang

tools.name: wakatime_get_all_time_since_today
tools.description: Total coding time since the user's WakaTime account (or one project) was created, with daily average and the range covered. GET /users/current/all_time_since_today.

tools.name: wakatime_get_status_bar_today
tools.description: Today's coding activity as shown in an editor status bar: grand total plus breakdowns by project, language, editor and more. Cached data only; an empty summary means the cache is still being filled. GET /users/current/status_bar/today.

tools.name: wakatime_get_insight
tools.description: One WakaTime insight for a range: stats, weekdays (average per weekday), days (per-day totals, optionally one weekday), ai_days, best_day, daily_average, or a breakdown by projects, languages, editors, categories, machines or operating_systems. GET /users/current/insights/{insight_type}/{range}.

tools.name: wakatime_get_durations
tools.description: The coding sessions (durations) of one day, each with start time, length in seconds and the project (or other slice) it belongs to. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/durations.

tools.name: wakatime_get_heartbeats
tools.description: The raw heartbeats (activity pings from editor plugins) of one day: entity (file path or domain), type, category, project, branch, language, time, lines and AI line changes. Large days are cut to `limit` heartbeats starting at `offset`; total_heartbeats says how many the day has. Needs the read_hear

tools.name: wakatime_list_projects
tools.description: The user's WakaTime projects with id, name, repository, color, clients, first and last heartbeat time and badge/public-url flags. Optionally filter by a name search. GET /users/current/projects.

tools.name: wakatime_list_machines
tools.description: The machines (computers) that sent coding activity: id, name, host name, IP, timezone and last-seen time. GET /users/current/machine_names.

tools.name: wakatime_list_user_agents
tools.description: The editor and plugin user agents that sent coding activity: editor, version, OS, AI model if any, and last-seen time. GET /users/current/user_agents.

tools.name: wakatime_list_commits
tools.description: Commits of a WakaTime project with the time spent coding on each (needs a connected repository). Filter by author or branch; paged. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/projects/{project}/commits.

tools.name: wakatime_get_commit
tools.description: One commit of a WakaTime project by hash, with the time spent coding on it. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/projects/{project}/commits/{hash}.

tools.name: wakatime_list_goals
tools.description: The user's coding goals: title, type, target seconds, status, chart data per period, languages/projects/editors it covers and who it is shared with. Needs the read_goals scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/goals.

tools.name: wakatime_get_goal
tools.description: One goal by id with its chart data (cached; an empty chart means the cache is still building, retry shortly). GET /users/current/goals/{goal}.

tools.name: wakatime_list_orgs
tools.description: The WakaTime organizations the user belongs to: id, name, people count, keystroke timeout and timezone preferences and what the user may do. Needs the read_orgs scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/orgs.

tools.name: wakatime_list_org_dashboards
tools.description: The dashboards of an organization: id, name, timezone, member count and what the user may view or join. GET /users/current/orgs/{org}/dashboards.

tools.name: wakatime_list_org_dashboard_members
tools.description: The members of an organization dashboard: id, username, full name, email, photo and whether their activity is view-only hidden. GET /users/current/orgs/{org}/dashboards/{dashboard}/members.

tools.name: wakatime_get_org_dashboard_summaries
tools.description: One day of coding activity for every developer on an organization dashboard (grand total plus breakdowns per member). GET /users/current/orgs/{org}/dashboards/{dashboard}/summaries.

tools.name: wakatime_get_org_member_summaries
tools.description: One dashboard member's coding activity as daily summaries for a date range (give start and end, or a named range). GET /users/current/orgs/{org}/dashboards/{dashboard}/members/{member}/summaries.

tools.name: wakatime_list_private_leaderboards
tools.description: The private leaderboards the user is in: id, name, time range, member count and edit rights. Needs the read_private_leaderboards scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/leaderboards.

tools.name: wakatime_get_private_leaderboard
tools.description: The ranking of a private leaderboard: rank, member and total coding time (or AI lines / AI spend) per language, country and board type; paged (without page it starts at the user's own page). GET /users/current/leaderboards/{board}.

tools.name: wakatime_get_public_leaders
tools.description: WakaTime's public leaderboard of the most active coders over the last 7 days, filterable by language, country, hireable badge and ranking type; paged. Each leader is reduced to rank, name, username, country, total and daily-average time and top 3 languages. GET /leaders.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wakatime_get_user, wakatime_list_projects, wakatime_list_org_dashboard_members · Private data: wakatime_get_summaries, wakatime_get_durations, wakatime_get_heartbeats, wakatime_list_commits, wakatime_get_commit, wakatime_list_goals, wakatime_list_orgs, wakatime_list_private_leaderboards, wakatime_get_private_leaderboard · Public sink: wakatime_get_user, wakatime_list_org_dashboard_members.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wakatime_get_user, wakatime_list_projects, wakatime_list_org_dashboard_members · Private data: wakatime_get_summaries, wakatime_get_durations, wakatime_get_heartbeats, wakatime_list_commits, wakatime_get_commit, wakatime_list_goals, wakatime_list_orgs, wakatime_list_private_leaderboards, wakatime_get_private_leaderboard · Public sink: wakatime_get_user, wakatime_list_org_dashboard_members

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
